🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: mixed sector returns (Energy, Consumer Staples, Real Estate positive vs Technology, Industrials weak) and broad leadership across sectors (Top 5 from 5 different sectors) — major mega-cap divergences temper a stronger regime call.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy leads: MPC (1W: +6.21% | 1M: +28.90%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +5.92% | 1M: +30.67%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +5.30% | 1M: +24.90%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Staples: PM (1W: +6.95% | 1M: +8.29%) ABOVE TREND. Real Estate: VTR (1W: +4.55% | 1M: +17.85%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology lagging: ORCL (1W: -7.72% | 1M: -33.63%) BELOW TREND, LRCX (1W: -7.02% | 1M: -18.02%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -0.12% | 1M: -0.67%) BELOW TREND. Industrials weak: CAT (1W: -7.04% | 1M: -9.42%) BELOW TREND. Communication weak: NFLX (1W: -8.44% | 1M: -12.16%) BELOW TREND.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: PYPL (1W: +19.24% | 1M: +35.03%) ABOVE TREND, ABT (1W: +11.16% | 1M: +15.69%) ABOVE TREND, ROST (1W: +7.44% | 1M: +1.08%) ABOVE TREND, PM (1W: +6.95% | 1M: +8.29%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +6.21% | 1M: +28.90%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (5 sectors in Top 5).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: IBM (1W: -26.61% | 1M: -18.81%) BELOW TREND, AMAT (1W: -8.64% | 1M: -11.34%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -7.72% | 1M: -33.63%) BELOW TREND, QCOM (1W: -7.42% | 1M: -20.03%) BELOW TREND, LRCX (1W: -7.02% | 1M: -18.02%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Technology/CapEx names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: PYPL (1W: +19.24% | 1M: +35.03%) ABOVE TREND, ABT (1W: +11.16% | 1M: +15.69%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +5.56% | 1M: +23.58%) ABOVE TREND. Note major divergence: multiple mega-caps in CORRECTION (META, JNJ, UNH, LLY) — tactical caution as trend signals conflict.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed to weak; sector 1W: -2.74% with notable dispersion. AAPL (1W: +2.92% | 1M: +10.35%) ABOVE TREND and MSFT (1W: +2.89% | 1M: +6.17%) ABOVE TREND contrast with ORCL (1W: -7.72% | 1M: -33.63%) BELOW TREND and LRCX (1W: -7.02% | 1M: -18.02%) BELOW TREND.

8. Financials Outlook?
Patchy but constructive. JPM (1W: +1.30% | 1M: +2.08%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +0.79% | 1M: +9.14%) ABOVE TREND and MA (1W: +1.81% | 1M: +11.23%) ABOVE TREND underpin the sector’s modest positive 1W return.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Mixed with dispersion and short-term pullbacks. ABT (1W: +11.16% | 1M: +15.69%) ABOVE TREND versus ISRG (1W: -13.25% | 1M: -12.19%) BELOW TREND; JNJ (1W: -3.47% | 1M: +6.24%) and LLY (1W: -2.96% | 1M: +3.14%) are in CORRECTION.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor exposure to Energy and select Consumer Staples/Financials showing ABOVE TREND — e.g., MPC (1W: +6.21% | 1M: +28.90%) ABOVE TREND and PM (1W: +6.95% | 1M: +8.29%) ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to the weakest Technology capex names like ORCL (1W: -7.72% | 1M: -33.63%) BELOW TREND and AMAT (1W: -8.64% | 1M: -11.34%) BELOW TREND. Style: mixed / no clear leadership given sector dispersion and mega-cap divergences.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: PYPL (1W: +19.24% | 1M: +35.03%) ABOVE TREND, ABT (1W: +11.16% | 1M: +15.69%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +6.21% | 1M: +28.90%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: ORCL (1W: -7.72% | 1M: -33.63%) BELOW TREND, IBM (1W: -26.61% | 1M: -18.81%) BELOW TREND, NFLX (1W: -8.44% | 1M: -12.16%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +2.68% | 1M: +10.77%) — momentum intact; Consumer Staples (1W: +0.97% | 1M: +2.96%) — defensive support. BEARISH: Technology (1W: -2.74% | 1M: -1.33%) and Industrials (1W: -1.08% | 1M: -1.29%) — watch earnings/guide risk.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch NVDA (1W: -0.12% | 1M: -0.67%) BELOW TREND for a sustained 1M breakdown as a trigger for broader tech weakness; monitor PYPL (1W: +19.24% | 1M: +35.03%) ABOVE TREND for follow-through above recent breakout volume; flag ORCL (1W: -7.72% | 1M: -33.63%) BELOW TREND — further downside would signal deeper tech capex pain.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
PYPL (+55): PayPal takeover chatter headline; price confirming — PYPL (1W: +19.24% | 1M: +35.03%) ABOVE TREND and sentiment confirmed. BA (+55): Farnborough headlines supportive but price diverges — BA (1W: -2.80% | 1M: -7.16%) BELOW TREND, watch for follow-through.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
ORCL (-80): $7bn collateral bill headline and price confirming — ORCL (1W: -7.72% | 1M: -33.63%) BELOW TREND. PFE (-50): international patent lawsuits headline but price diverging — PFE (1W: +1.10% | 1M: -4.51%) RECOVERY. NFLX (-45): post-earnings negative headlines and price confirming — NFLX (1W: -8.44% | 1M: -12.16%) BELOW TREND.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. PYPL (1W: +19.24% | 1M: +35.03%) ABOVE TREND and Energy names like MPC (1W: +6.21% | 1M: +28.90%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength. Key risk: major mega-cap divergences and negative sentiment on ORCL (1W: -7.72% | 1M: -33.63%) BELOW TREND — watch for trend breaks.
